# basic-auth-parser

> HTTP auth header parsing (Basic, Bearer, Digest) with timing-safe credential comparison.

Parses Authorization headers for Basic (base64, first-colon-only split for password safety), Bearer token extraction, and Digest challenge field parsing (quoted-string aware). Includes timing-safe comparison helper (crypto.timingSafeEqual with buffer length guard) and WWW-Authenticate challenge builder for all three schemes.

## API

```typescript
function parseBasic(header: string): { username, password } | null
function parseBearer(header: string): string | null
function parseDigest(header: string): Record<string, string> | null
function timingSafeCompare(a: string, b: string): boolean
function buildWWWAuthenticate(scheme, options?): string
```

## Install

```bash
npm install basic-auth-parser
```

## Limits

- Digest parsing extracts fields only (no response verification)
- No schema negotiation (parse one scheme per call)

Part of the Ferrow open-source toolkit: https://github.com/FerrowAI/ferrow-toolkit — sponsored by https://ferrow.ai
